study: DS24 receiver and causal orbital uncertainty controls
cohort: All 24 successful DS24 fast scans from the frozen channel-half comparison; ten unavailable scans remain unavailable
reference_method: ALGO02-v1 plus qualified causal signed phase prior and equal-assignment family cavity
candidate_families: receiver-specific graph-based frequency-noise law versus pooled learner
shared receiver discrepancy justified by random whole-family predictive witness
marginal-scale-preserving orbital correlation only if causal grouped forecasting and physical-basis checks qualify
qualification: Each candidate freezes RF-only grouped prediction evidence before its position evaluation; no evaluation GPS selects a candidate
position_policy: Separate candidate policies: RF-qualified and original paired gates pass, otherwise retain exact baseline pair; no GPS-best combination
c_ablation: c=0 and fitted c with the same original observations, masks, identities, aliases, powers, other priors and search budget within each candidate
position_budget: Cold regional [0,0], original 25x25 km box, five phase rounds and 48 position iterations per round; 240 s case cap
scope: Frozen-association model controls, not a fresh acquisition/GLRT/full-catalogue rerun
scientific_limits: Previously selected graph tracks and labels remain conditional inputs; random grouping does not make this an untouched end-to-end test set
Graph-polynomial residuals and later historical TLEs are uncertainty proxies, not independent physical truth
New forecast validations randomize whole independent groups, fit preprocessing on training only and enforce causal feature availability
Post-scan TLEs never enter inference or qualification
RF score, association coverage and position error are reported separately
